payload.reason: The evidence provides information on the feature extraction process and the use of cluster membership features in various tasks, indicating how clusters were utilized in the analysis.

claims.text: Clusters were extracted using a feature extraction pipeline that includes n-gram features, part-of-speech counts, and sentiment scores.
The study suggests that incorporating cluster membership features improves performance in tasks like Named-Entity recognition and sentiment classification.
The effectiveness of cluster membership features was empirically shown to benefit performance across multiple tasks.
